stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait before you start. The game switches to landscape on its own when it needs to
stumbles.why: If rotation is locked in portrait, the phone won't rotate to landscape. Step 3 then tells you to turn the phone to landscape, and it's unclear how a locked screen switches. The 'on its own' claim conflicts with that.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone in portrait for the first screen
stumbles.why: Step 1 says the game switches to landscape 'when it needs to', but the text doesn't say when. It also doesn't say which control you use to move from the options screen to the prompt.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate, and towards you to brake.
stumbles.why: The text doesn't say whether this applies in landscape. In landscape, 'the top of the phone' is ambiguous because it could mean the top edge in the current orientation. It also doesn't say which landscape direction (left or right edge down) the game expects.

stumbles.quote: Hold it in the position you want to drive from until the start lights go out.
stumbles.why: 'Start lights' are never introduced. It isn't stated whether they appear after the prompt or how long the wait is. It's also unclear whether tilting before then matters.

point: To play, you open the page on a phone with a motion sensor, lock portrait, pick track, laps and difficulty, turn to landscape when prompted, and hold a comfortable neutral position until the lights go out. Then you steer by tilting left or right and use forward and back tilt for gas and brake.
